concerns.text: T108 instructs writing to 'specs/518-brain-dynamics-creativity/research.md', but the actual project directory is 'specs/001-investigating-the-relationship-between-b/' (as this artifact's own path shows). The path does not exist; the task is not executable as written. Same stale prefix appears in the header 'Input: /specs/518-brain-dynamics-creativity/'.

T102's sensitivity_summary.csv deliverable specifies only columns window_length, correlation, empirical_p_value, but the contract requires window_length, correlation_coefficient, p_value, permutation_p_value, n_samples (additionalProperties: false). The produced table would fail contract validation; the task's deliverable and verification are contradictory. Align column spec with the schema.

US-3 scenario 1 requires 'an empirical p-value is written to permutation_results.csv', but T102 defines that file as one row per shuffle with only shuffle_id and correlation, placing the p-value in regression_summary.csv. The task as specified cannot satisfy its cited acceptance scenario; either add the p-value to permutation_results.csv or note the spec amendment.

T101 fixes plot_residuals to use RegressionResult field 'fitted_values', but the contract schema (additionalProperties: false) defines no such field. Either the schema must add fitted_values/residuals or the task must specify where these arrays come from; as written the fix would produce a contract-violating object.

T103 has a 'Checkpoint' but no concrete verification command or artifact: 'Record the actual Pearson r... in regression_summary.csv' names no test, no file check, no command. Add an executable verification (e.g., pytest assertion or explicit file/schema check) so done-ness is determinable.

T106's verification requires regenerated artifact checksums to 'match a second run', but PNG outputs (matplotlib) and run logs with timestamps are not guaranteed byte-identical across runs. Restrict the checksum-match requirement to the deterministic CSV artifacts, or specify plot determinism (e.g., fixed matplotlib metadata/source_date_epoch).

T104 says 'Write the missing unit tests... covering: ...' without naming the test functions. Name at least the test ids (e.g., test_calculate_flexibility_averages_rois, test_permutation_seed_reproducibility) so the deliverable is concrete and the pytest verification is checkable.
